# JSON-Schema-Test-Suite (subset)

From https://github.com/json-schema-org/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite at commit
`3f05891cac5d51ffa068d7076d1372130e00c829`, unmodified, under its MIT license (`LICENSE`).

Only what the drafts this package supports use:

- `tests/draft2020-12/` and `tests/draft7/`, complete (core, `optional/`, `optional/format/`);
- `remotes/`: the documents those tests reference (served as `http://localhost:1234/...` in the tests).
